title: Dadak Merak
subject: a young pembarong in Ponorogo training to hold the fifty-kilogram dadak merak peacock mask by his teeth, three weeks before the Grebeg Suro festival
caption: Reog Ponorogo gamelan pop, the East Javanese reog street ensemble carrying a sung song. A slompret double-reed shawm playing a piercing, wailing lead line; kendang and ketipung drums driving fast interlocking patterns with sharp slaps and cue breaks; kempul and kenong on the off-beats with a big gong closing every cycle; angklung reog rattling in tight bursts; a plain electric bass doubling the gong tones. Open-air and loud, close-miked like a troupe recorded in a village hall yard. Young male tenor vocal, bright and strained, chanting the verses and shouting the chorus, with a group of male and female voices answering. 132 BPM, D minor. Sweaty, proud and rowdy. No koplo drum machine, no dangdut suling, no campursari keyboard, no EDM drop, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - kendang roll and slompret]

[Verse 1]
Lima puluh kilo, kepala macan, bulu merak
Kugigit kayu di dalamnya, leherku jadi tiang
Pak Warok hitung pakai jari, baru sampai dua belas
Rahangku gemetar, keringat masuk ke mata

[Pre-Chorus]
Anak-anak jathil cekikikan di bawah pohon sawo
Mas, merakmu miring ke kiri lagi

[Chorus - male lead with group shouts]
Angkat, angkat, dadak merak
Gigit yang kuat, jangan sampai rebah
Kendang makin cepat, slompret makin nyaring
Grebeg Suro tinggal tiga minggu lagi

[Verse 2]
Tiap sore latihan di belakang balai desa
Bujang Ganong salto, aku cuma bisa muter
Bapak-bapak warung kopi ikut kasih saran
Pundaknya, Le, pundaknya, jangan cuma gigi

[Pre-Chorus]
Malam ini Pak Warok hitung sampai enam puluh
Aku masih berdiri, merak masih tegak

[Chorus - male lead with group shouts]
Angkat, angkat, dadak merak
Gigit yang kuat, biar alun-alun bergetar
Kendang makin cepat, slompret makin nyaring
Grebeg Suro, ayo, gigiku sudah siap

[Bridge - kendang break and group shouts]
Ganong, jathil, warok, semua masuk lingkaran
Satu, dua, tiga, merak diangkat lebih tinggi

[Outro - slompret alone, one gong]
Rahangku pegal sampai pagi
Tapi bulu meraknya utuh semua
